div.head: Rect 13, 13.1
div.ab: [13] Be kuhyrde. Cuhyrde gebyreð, þæt he hæbbe ealdre cu meolc VII niht, syððan heo nige cealfod hæfð, 7 frymetlinge bystinge XIIII niht. [13.1] 7 ga his metecu mid hlafordes cu.
[13] Uaccarii rectum est, ut habeat lac uacce ueteris VII noctibus, postquam enixa erit, et primitiuarum bistinguium XIIII noctibus. [13.1] Et eat eius uacca cum uaccis domini.
Be ku hyrde . Cuhyrde gebyreð þæt he hæbbe ealdre cu meolc .vii. niht syððan heo nige cealfod heafð 7 frymetlinge bystin|ge .xiiii. niht 7 ga his mete cu mid hlafordes cu.
Be kuhyrde Cuhyrde gebyreð, þæt he hæbbe ealdre cu meolc VII niht syððan heo nige cealfod hæfð and frymetlinge bystinge xiiii niht. [13.1] And ga his metecu mid hlafordes cu.

[13] Vom Kuhhirten. Dem Kuhhirten gebührt, dass er von [jeder] ausgewachsenen Kuh [bei der herrschaftlichen Domäne] sieben Tage, nachdem sie neu gekalbt hat, die Milch erhalte und die Biestmilch [jeder] jungen [erstmals kalbenden] 14 Tage. [13.1] Und seine Nährkuh gehe mit des Herrn Kuh [weiden].

[13] Of the cowherd. To the cowherd is due that he receive the milk of [each] full-grown cow [on the lord's demesne] for seven days after she has newly calved, and the beestings of [each] young [first-calving] cow for 14 days. [13.1] And let his food-cow go [to pasture] with the lord's cow.

Concerning the cowherd To the cowherd is due that he has the milk of a mature cow for seven nights after she has had a new calf, and the colostrum of a young cow for fourteen nights. And his food cow [may] go with the lord’s cow[s].

Regarding the Cowherd For the cowherd, it is appropriate that he have the milk of a mature cow for seven nights after she bears a new calf and the colostrum of a young cow for fourteen nights. [13.1] And the cow he intends for food may go with the lord’s cows.
